## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run module -- check` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Each changed module has a new version (`npm run module -- release <module> patch|minor|major "…"`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] A requirement that changes what it does, or is now built, has its row updated in `docs/TRACEABILITY.md`
- [ ] New interface text reads well in Sinhala and Tamil, or is added to the catalogues as a draft (`docs/localization/README.md`)
